citations.claim: At first violating step 102 body is moving at ~49.65 m/s while controller reports force 762.86 far above fmax 6.27
One step earlier at step 101 speed is nearly identical (~49.68 m/s) but force was clamped to fmax 6.27, showing clamp was applied before and missed at step 102
At step 100 speed also ~49.68 m/s with clamped force, confirming steady high velocity error before the spike

counterfactual.change: Reduced kp from 16.3366 to 0.005, keeping fmax, vcmd, waypoint, body and steps identical; this keeps demanded kp*velocity-error below fmax so no clamping is needed and violation disappears.

explanation: Velocity-error law demands ~kp*|v_desired - v| ≈ 16.3*~46 ≈ 760 N, far above fmax 6.27. Steps 50,100,101 correctly clamp to 6.2705, but at step 102 the same large demand (speed 49.65 m/s, waypoint still at (0.4,5.7)) is returned unclamped as 762.86 N. Likely cause is a missed/incorrect force-magnitude clamp on that step/path (e.g. clamping skipped or applied to wrong vector), not a physics change.
vision_note: The red controller-driven body sits just right of the green waypoint near the left edge with almost no movement across steps 99 to 101, then shifts slightly downward at step 102. There is no visible collision, new waypoint, or sudden jump that would change the control demand.
